agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  CONSTRUCTION APPEALS BOARD
  MEETING AGENDA

February 13, 2024 6:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Vote on meeting chair.

4.  Communications from staff.

5.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Item(s). Persons wishing to
  address the Construction Appeals Board on any item on the agenda
  may do so at this time.

6.  This Construction Appeals Board meeting is being held to review
  the Board’s responsibility.

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Construction Appeals
  Board on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Adjournment.

If you require special accommodations due to a disability, please contact
the Building Safety Division at (310) 412-5294, One Manchester Boulevard,
Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for
special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to the day of the
meeting(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5294."

In the event that the Construction Appeals Board meeting of February 13,
2024, is not held, or is concluded prior to the agenda item(s) being
considered, the agenda item(s) will automatically be continued to the
next Construction Appeals Board meeting.

  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
